title: Task create refuses a record that task-quality would fail in CI
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15 S1 #1104: t-ab00km6 was created without a measurable Outcome; only npm run lint in CI caught it (run 43758528920), costing one CI round.
Outcome: `krn task create` and `krn task edit` exit 65 with the task-quality message when the record fails scripts/task-quality.ts, and write nothing.
Proof: a test creates a task whose Outcome has no count, exit code or named output and gets exit 65 and no tasks/<id>.json.
